peopleAlsoAsk.question: Why is glycerol used in cryopreservation?
peopleAlsoAsk.snippet: Glycerol is a molecule that protects cells from freezing injury mainly by reducing intracellular ice crystal formation and osmotic pressure differences [11]. This molecule has been studied as a CPA for composite tissues such as testicular tissue [11], ovarian tissue [12], bones and cartilage [13].
